analysis.title: DB CoTD: From Silicon to Cyclicals
key_insights: DB equity strategists Binky Chadha and Parag Thatte expect S&P 500 Q3 earnings growth of +34% YoY, matching Q2 and well ahead of the +27% consensus.
The +34% growth rate would be a record outside recessionary bounce-backs.

Three tailwinds drive S&P 500 Q3 earnings: AI demand growth (+54% YoY, contributing 20pp to the headline), cyclical growth ex-Tech, Energy & Materials (+14%, contributing 8pp), and higher oil and commodity prices (+108% for Energy & Materials, contributing 7pp).
Financials are expected to be among the weaker sectors for YoY earnings growth, even as several large financials report today.
DB expects European Q3 earnings growth of +25%, about 5pp above consensus, with the season starting in earnest next week.
DB strategists downgraded Tech to neutral in their weekly piece on Friday, despite expected stellar Tech earnings growth.
Given Tech's index weight, the downgrade is a potential headwind for headline indices, but DB argues rotation into other sectors on the back of strong earnings should offset it.
Broadening of earnings growth could favour the more cyclical European market at the margin.
